title: NTFS (New Technology File System) signature
summary: NTFS volume boot record begins with a 3-byte jump instruction (EB 52 90 or EB 5B 90), followed by the 8-byte OEM ID 'NTFS    ' (0x4E 0x54 0x46 0x53 0x20 0x20 0x20 0x20) at offset 3.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: OEM ID: 'NTFS    ' (NTFS followed by 4 spaces) at offset 3.
Bytes per sector (offset 0x0B), sectors per cluster (0x0D), total sectors (0x28), MFT cluster number (0x30), MFT mirror cluster (0x38).
NTFS uses a Master File Table (MFT) with 1024-byte records per file.
NTFS supports journaling, ACLs, compression, encryption (EFS), and sparse files.
